execution_properties_reviewed: Initialization can only originate from the immutable canonical factory and cannot repeat.
Factory creation either leaves one registered active clone with its configured prize or reverts all effects.
Each successful purchase adds exactly entryCount paid entries and one ticket with a unique nonoverlapping range.
All caller-controlled recipient, quantity, ticket ID, timestamp branch, and value relationships were traced.
No protected claim operation can reenter another protected operation in the same clone.
Inherited unguarded ticket transfers preserve owner authorization and remain consistent with bearer claims.
An accepted draw fixes totalEntries and persists its request ID before asynchronous resolution.
Authenticated callbacks cannot select an entry during an in-flight request or after either terminal outcome.
Exact deadlines partition request, callback, and refund paths without an overlap.
Winner settlement allocates the entire unsettled pot once without any asset call or ownership dependency.
Burned or nonexistent tickets cannot produce a second refund or winner payment.
Prize or quote transfer failure restores the claim and ticket through transaction rollback.
Sponsor and protocol releases consume separate liabilities before external transfers.
Native refund failure rolls back the VRF request and its local state.
Contract-level state and liability accounting remain isolated between fixed-target clones.
Maximum entry totals bound gross pot arithmetic below uint256 and ticketCount below uint128.

considered_paths_without_reportable_expl.path: Predicted future clone as ticket owner or sponsor recipient
considered_paths_without_reportable_expl.result: Requires the sender or sponsor to choose an inaccessible address; no source path takes an honest owner's claim without authorization.

considered_paths_without_reportable_expl.path: Foreign-factory raffle tickets as prizes or destinations
considered_paths_without_reportable_expl.result: Same-factory registry checks do not recognize foreign deployments; no non-self-harm loss path was established.

considered_paths_without_reportable_expl.path: Dishonest prize supportsInterface or ownerOf return values
considered_paths_without_reportable_expl.result: A dishonest token can misreport its own custody; the source declares supported prizes honest and standards-compliant, and no honest-token custody bypass was established.
Protected functions reject reentry; authorized ticket transfers do not alter entry ranges or draw identity.

considered_paths_without_reportable_expl.path: Reentrant mint receiver or prize transfer callback
considered_paths_without_reportable_expl.result: Checks, lifecycle gates, ownership authorization, and complete rollback prevent a second claim or inconsistent committed allocation.

gaps_and_limitations: No runtime proof was executed because no concrete exploit path was confirmed.
Only supplied dependency source was assessed; canonical USDC and the deployed VRF wrapper implementation and configuration were not supplied.
The clean design calls prize contracts untrusted, while the interfaces require honest standard ERC721 behavior; arbitrary false token semantics cannot establish real custody.
